title: PS4 Startup
blurb: Smooth, warm and entirely without menace, the PlayStation 4's boot chime says the evening's plans are now formally settled. It has none of the ominous drama of the original PS1 sequence. Sony had moved on from announcing a new era to quietly reassuring you the machine was ready, and what the chime lacks in theatre it makes up for in polish. Anyone who bought one at launch in 2013 will already file this under nostalgia. Play it when settling in for something you have no intention of leaving early, whatever you told people.
origin: The boot sound from the PlayStation 4 (Sony, 2013).
